action-view.name: action-lvme-rotation-stock-dashlet
action-view.title: Rotation des stocks
action-view.domain: (:_artDu = '' OR self.productCode >= :_artDu) AND (:_artAu = '' OR self.productCode <= :_artAu) AND (:_famille = 0 OR self.productCategory.id = :_famille) AND (:_statut = '' OR self.statut = :_statut) AND (:_couvMax = 0 OR (self.daysOfStock IS NOT NULL AND self.daysOfStock < :_couvMax)) AND (:_ageMin = 0 OR (self.avgAgeDays IS NOT NULL AND self.avgAgeDays > :_ageMin)) AND (:_dormant = false OR self.isDormant = true)

context.name: _artAu
context.expr: eval: articleAu?.id ? (__repo__(Product).find(articleAu.id as Long)?.code ?: '') : (articleDu?.id ? (__repo__(Product).find(articleDu.id as Long)?.code ?: '') : '')
